name: TEM1 Kinetics Characterization
description: Standalone (non-CFPS) kinetics characterization: purified TEM1 enzyme x nitrocefin substrate concentration grid, plus enzyme-only and substrate-only blanks, read kinetically on the plate reader. Prerequisite round for the CFPS inhibitor dose-response screen — its fit sets the nitrocefin working concentration and endpoint read timing used there. Grid is 3x3 (enzyme levels x substrate levels) plus 2 blanks by default; extend by copying a grid-point block. Robot half only: the arm builds the plate, loads it into the reader and closes the lid, then stops. The kinetic read and plate retrieval are manual for now.

nodes.label: Close Reader Lid (run ends here)
nodes.description: Final robot action. The plate is left loaded in the closed reader: the operator starts the kinetic read in Gen5 by hand and retrieves the plate afterwards. platereader_measure is not called — automated kinetic reads are still in progress on Zeon's side.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: run started
nodes.description: Registers this execution in data/logs/ before any hardware moves, so a run that fails early is still visible to the tracker instead of leaving nothing behind. Its outgoing edge is deliberately 'default', not 'on_success': a checkpoint is bookkeeping, and a failure to record progress must never abort a run that is physically fine. The validator flags this as unconditional — that is the intent.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: pipetting done
nodes.description: Refreshes the run folder once all pipetting is complete, before labware handling — so a failure during plate/reader moves still has every dispensed leg on record. Its outgoing edge is deliberately 'default', not 'on_success': a checkpoint is bookkeeping, and a failure to record progress must never abort a run that is physically fine. The validator flags this as unconditional — that is the intent.
